mainEntity.name: What does a wood privacy fence cost in Oakland County?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom wood privacy fence in Oakland County typically costs between $4,500 and $6,000 for a standard 200-linear-foot backyard installation, including posts set 42 inches deep, concrete footings, gates, and premium pressure-treated pine materials. Prices vary based on property size, accessibility, material choices, and gate configurations. Contact BF Fence for a free custom estimate.

mainEntity.name: How deep should fence posts be in Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fence posts in Michigan should be set at least 42 inches deep — below the frost line — to prevent heaving and leaning caused by the freeze-thaw cycle. A gravel drainage base at the bottom of each hole is also essential to prevent water pooling at the base of the post.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a fence in Auburn Hills, Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the City of Auburn Hills requires permits for fence installation. Backyard privacy fences are generally allowed up to 6 feet in height, while front yard fences are limited to 3-4 feet. Setback requirements and HOA rules may also apply. BF Fence handles the permit process for homeowners.

mainEntity.name: What's the best wood for a privacy fence in Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Michigan's climate, pressure-treated pine and cedar are the best choices. Pressure-treated pine offers excellent durability at a moderate price point. Cedar is naturally rot-resistant with a beautiful grain pattern but costs more. Both handle Michigan's freeze-thaw cycles well when properly installed with posts set below the frost line.

mainEntity.name: How long does a wood privacy fence last in Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: A quality wood privacy fence in Michigan can last 15-20 years with proper installation and regular maintenance. Posts must be set below the frost line. Using premium-grade pressure-treated wood, hot-dipped galvanized hardware, and applying stain or sealant every 3-4 years will maximize fence life.
